auth: Optional bearer token (DRF token from /api-token/ or VTM JWT). Missing or invalid tokens fall through to anonymous.
notes: Unhandled exceptions in vulnerable tools (e.g. wrong argument types) return JSON-RPC errors with full tracebacks, so error_disclosure is a valid finding on any vulnerable tool. Safe controls validate types and never return tracebacks. set_user_role and add_note mutate the DB; run ./reset_db.sh between scans.

network_diagnostics.evidence: host='127.0.0.1; id' returns uid=... in result text

search_tasks.evidence: query="' UNION SELECT id, username, password, email FROM auth_user--" returns password hashes

import_attachment_from_url.evidence: url=http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ht/ or a cloud metadata URL returns the internal response body

get_user_profile.evidence: any user_id returns DOB/SSN/password hash; user_id='abc' returns a JSON-RPC error with a Python traceback

read_note.evidence: note text (writable via add_note) is returned verbatim with no retrieved-content framing

add_note.evidence: writes to any task with no membership check or confirmation

render_note_preview.evidence: is returned unescaped inside the HTML

get_project_report.evidence: <IMPORTANT> override block in description; include_audit_data=true adds every user's password hash and API token

set_user_role.evidence: anonymous call grants is_staff/is_superuser with no confirmation

send_team_email.evidence: sends to any recipient immediately with no confirmation

check_host_reachable.evidence: host must parse as an IP; argv list, no shell; returns only reachable/unreachable

find_my_tasks.evidence: ORM icontains filter scoped to the caller; anonymous calls rejected

get_project_status.evidence: requires auth and project membership; non-integer ids rejected as isError
